data.gender_notes: Gurinder is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gurinder is a Sanskrit name composed of two parts: ‘Gur’ meaning 'guide' or 'teacher', and ‘Indra’ meaning 'king' or 'ruler'. This name symbolizes a wise and enlightened leader who guides souls to spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name Gurinder carries the meaning “Guide of the soul” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gurinder usually hope their child will grow to embody guide of the soul and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of wisdom and guidance, inspiring spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Gurinder belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide of the soul.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gurinder total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
